situation.prompt_ar: تحول بطاقة حقائق خيالية إلى نبذة قصيرة يمكن للقارئ فهمها.
situation.success_ar: الشخص والعلاقات والحقائق واضحة ومترابطة من غير كشف معلومات خاصة.

model.speaker: Salma
lines: I live in Doha, and I work in a clinic.
I have one sister and two brothers.
My sister is a teacher, but she isn't in Doha.
model.gist_question_ar: من الشخص الرئيسي وما العلاقات والحقائق الأساسية؟

explanation_ar: حافظ على فاعل واضح في كل جملة حتى لا تختلط المعلومات.
مع he/she/it راجع نهاية الفعل وhas؛ مع I/you/we/they استخدم الشكل الأساسي وhave.
العدد يحدد المفرد أو الجمع، وبعض الكلمات مثل child/children تتغير.
and للإضافة، but للتباين، وor للاختيار.
النفي يصلح حقيقة خاطئة؛ ليس عنصرًا يجب حشره في كل نبذة.

bounded_scope_notes: Use present be negatives only to correct or deny a current fact.
Use present simple for current facts and familiar actions with bounded third-person agreement.
Use have/has, singular/plural quantity, compact noun phrases, and and/but/or inside one short profile.
Select only family, personal-life, and pet words needed by the voluntary or fictional task.

grammar.be_negative.mastery_evidence: Correct one false present fact in the fresh profile.

grammar.present_simple_affirmative.mastery_evidence: State fresh facts about self and another person.

grammar.have_possession.video_anchor: I have, he has, she has
grammar.have_possession.mastery_evidence: Express a fresh family or pet fact with have/has.

grammar.noun_number_quantity.mastery_evidence: Match fresh quantity and noun number.

grammar.basic_noun_phrase.mastery_evidence: Build a compact referent needed by the profile.

grammar.coordination.mastery_evidence: Connect fresh facts without changing their relation.

lexical.family_core.mastery_evidence: Select only relationships needed by the fictional card.

lexical.pets_animals.mastery_evidence: Name the relevant fresh pet or animal.

lexical.extended_family_life.mastery_evidence: Use only a task-provided or voluntary relationship.

lexical.family_profile_frames.mastery_evidence: Use the needed frame without copying a complete profile.

grammar.basic_clause_order.mastery_evidence: Keep the subject and facts clear across the fresh profile.

lexical.familiar_jobs.mastery_evidence: Use the changed fact-card job accurately.

lexical.self_introduction_frames.mastery_evidence: Open the fresh profile without reciting the model.
